# Office Software Marketplace

> Independent reviews of office, finance, HR and IT software for small and mid-sized teams. 167 full reviews live here as the canonical version, 50 of them tested hands-on by us (listed below with the date and what we measured); prices are read on the vendor's page and dated. Last updated 2026-11-08.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

## Start here
- [Cost-trap atlas](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/atlas.html): every tool in this niche with its documented pricing traps
- [Price Watch](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/price-watch.html): dated price changes, free-tier cuts and renewal jumps
- [Deals](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/deals.html): current deals and free trials

## Tested hands-on (50): first-hand findings
We signed up and ran these tools ourselves. The date is the test date; the line is what we measured, not the vendor's claim. All other reviews are researched from the vendor's own pages and buyer reviews, and say so on the page.
- [BillingNow](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/billingnow-review.html): tested 2026-11-02. Measured 2026-11-02: We saw no trial banner or countdown anywhere, although the homepage promises a 3-day free trial; General settings simply showed 'Premium Plan'.
- [pCloud](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/pcloud-review.html): tested 2026-11-02. Measured 2026-11-02: The free account started at 2 GB of storage and became 3 GB after our first upload: one extra gigabyte unlocked by that action. The homepage says you can unlock up to 10 GB; we only saw the first step.
- [Recruit CRM](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/recruit-crm-review.html): tested 2026-11-02. Measured 2026-11-02: The exported Contact First Name values retained ë and è in both synthetic contacts despite this import warning.
- [VideoScribe](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/videoscribe-review.html): tested 2026-11-02. Measured 2026-11-02: The trial banner read 'Free Trial - 6 days 23h 58m 54s remaining', which matches the 7-day trial on the pricing page, and said to purchase to remove VideoScribe watermarks.
- [eBillity](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/ebillity-review.html): tested 2026-10-31. Measured 2026-10-31: The dashboard and activation screen showed fourteen trial days remaining.
- [Hubstaff](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/hubstaff-review.html): tested 2026-10-31. Measured 2026-10-31: Grow plan card says 4 seats minimum, while the annual Grow checkout says 2 seats minimum and shows $180.00 subtotal.
- [Leavo](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/leavo-review.html): tested 2026-10-31. Measured 2026-10-31: The wizard described thirty days and billing showed thirty days remaining.
- [Planday](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/planday-review.html): tested 2026-10-31. Measured 2026-10-31: The trial showed 30 days, with no card. The sign-up form requires a phone number.
- [Top Echelon](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/top-echelon-review.html): tested 2026-10-31. Measured 2026-10-31: The trial showed 30 days, with no card. The account came pre-filled with 100 sample people and 50 sample companies.

Both contacts then came in with their addresses.
